contract.application_relevance: Persist booleans, optional nulls, Unicode text, empty text and finite numbers without silent coercion to NULL.

cleanup.finally: For every claimed resource independently, DROP TABLE IF EXISTS and read sqlite_schema by exact name; require null and no cleanup errors. Deduplicate alias identities by owning only the canonical binding.
cleanup.on_stall: The separately reviewed adapter must enforce the total request deadline, stop only the owned invocation and, if request cancellation cannot be proved, the owned celld process group; preserve evidence then discard only its disposable store. No cleanup success may be inferred after timeout.
cleanup.preflight: For each declared physical identity/table, SELECT sqlite_schema by exact bound name and require absence before claiming ownership. Refuse pre-existing objects and never drop them. A fresh isolated store and serial runner remain mandatory.
cleanup.wave_end: Stop the owned celld group and discard its disposable store even if every finally check succeeds.

contract.intent: Persist booleans, optional nulls, Unicode text, empty text and finite numbers without silent coercion to NULL.
limits_of_evidence: Source-backed assertion candidate only; zero execution, zero review acceptance.
No cross-node, restart, durability-loss, fault, rollback, malformed-input, authorization or guarded G/N/P/J122 claim.
Successful batch dependencies do not establish concurrent-observer atomicity.
Finite source traces do not substitute for an independently enforced outer deadline and owned teardown.

assertions: boolean null text and finite number binds keep their intended SQL types and values
oracle.claim: The public client converts booleans to 1/0, preserves finite numbers/text/null, and the engine maps those JSON values to corresponding SQLite values.
executable_assertion_source: c.eq(result.results, [{id:1,enabled:1,optional:null,note:"café\nready",amount:2.5,flag_type:"integer",optional_type:"null",note_type:"text"},{id:2,enabled:0,optional:null,note:"",amount:0,flag_type:"integer",optional_type:"null",note_type:"text"}], "boolean null text and finite number binds keep their intended SQL types and values");
oracle.qualification: All expectations are against the exact pinned direct celld source. Metadata resets, primary service markers, stable bookmark, exec counts and database-name fallback are deliberately not universal Cloudflare claims. No runtime or workerd comparison was performed.

schedule.ordering: Every public dispatch is awaited before the next; no overlapping requests, timers, retries or random schedules. prepare/bind/session constructors/bookmark access are synchronous local operations.
